Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This expression redundantly combines a time period with a “time of” phrase. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住了在：住在，Residence is a continuing state here, so it does not take 了; use 在 directly before the place phrase. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，跟 means “together with” as equal participants, while a mother relocates with her child in her care. [vocab list]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 搬了到：搬到了，Place 了 after the directional/resultative part: 搬到 + 了. [teacher rule: le_placement]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个：另一个，Use 另一个 for one additional or different city; 别的 distinguishes other things from a specific one already mentioned. [teacher rule: bieren]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和母亲，On first mention, introduce the character with a name and identifying description rather than assuming the reader already knows who he is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子：他，After a recent mention of Mengzi and with no competing male character, use a pronoun for close re-occurrence. [rule: none]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在那里，The city has not been introduced, so the definite phrase is unclear; use a location reference to the previously mentioned home area. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，Mengmu was already named earlier in the same sentence, so a pronoun makes the reference smoother. [rule: none]
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，A routine marked by 每天 uses the zero particle, not 了, because it is not one completed action. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
住了在 has both incorrect 了 placement and an inappropriate completed aspect for a residence state, but 住在 alone is unfinished without a place.
孟母跟孩子搬家 is an acceptable way to say that she moved together with her child; 带着孩子 is only an optional rewording.
了 must follow 到 in 搬到了, but the displayed replacement is still incomplete without its destination.
别一个城市 is not the appropriate expression here; 另一个 can correctly mean another one.
孟子 needs a brief first-mention introduction, but the proposed replacement ends with the incomplete phrase 他和母亲.
孩子 is vague as the first later reference to Mengzi, while 他 is clear after the immediately preceding mention.
那个城市 presumes an already established city although none has been introduced; 在那里 can refer back to the preceding location.
Repeating 孟母 in 害得孟母没有钱 is acceptable and does not create an unclear reference; 她 is merely a possible alternative.
每天 describes a routine, so 祭拜 should use zero aspect rather than completed 了.
